How It Works

A combination of red light therapy and microcurrent stimulation targeting the under-eye area — boosting circulation, reducing puffiness, and supporting collagen production.

💡

Red Light (RLT)

Optimized-wavelength light that delivers energy to skin cells and encourages renewal.

⚡

Microcurrent

Gentle current that stimulates facial muscles and improves the look of your skin.

⏱️

5–10 Min a Day

A short, easy routine that fits into any day — at home or on the go.

How to Use — 6 Simple Steps

Easy to use, no special training required.

Clean Your Face

Start with clean, dry skin.

Serum (Optional)

Apply eye serum for best results.

Put On the Glasses

Position in snug contact with the eye area.

Select Intensity

Choose the comfort level that suits you.

5–10 Minutes

Relax while the device does its work.

Clean & Store

Wipe down and return to the case.

When Will You See Results?

First sessions

An immediate refreshed feeling and less tired-looking eyes.

2–3 weeks

Visible improvement in under-eye bags and dark circles.

Ongoing use

Sustained brightness and a refreshed look over time.

A unique combination of red light and microcurrent in a single portable device, designed for the delicate under-eye area.

The LumiGlow device, a USB charging cable, a carrying case, and a user guide.

With consistent use, results are maintained. Continued use is recommended for upkeep.
